name: Kuroba Saneaki
source:
Birthplace: Hizen Province
Sword: Magoroku Kanemoto
Style: Shintou-ryu + self-taught

A hidden Christian from Hizen Province. He lost his mother when he was small, and he was taken in by a Dutch merchant. He spent his childhood in a Dutch company in Hirato. He has a gentle personality, but he also has a unique atmosphere around him—it’s hard to tell what he’s thinking of. He’s secretive, and he puts distance between himself and other people. Due to a certain incident in the past, right now he has abandoned his sword and lives deep in a mountain in Edo.

[from [url=http://kokoronodamu.tumblr.com/post/36202686560/ken-ga-kimi-character-profiles/]kokoronodamu[/url]]
